question: In recognition technology OMR is used, what does M stand for?
solution:
The correct option is__** Mark**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **OMR** stands for **Optical Mark Recognition**. 
 
• The first mark sense scanner was the** IBM 805 Test Scoring Machine.**
 
• The first successful optical mark-sense scanner was developed by **Everett Franklin Lindquist**.
 
• Some applications of OMR are:
 
 
• **Data compilation**
 
• **Consumer surveys**
 
• **Lotteries and voting**
 
• **Geocoding etc**.
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** OCR** is the electronic or mechanical conversion of images of typed, handwritten or printed text into machine-encoded text.
 
• **Facial Recognition system** is a technology capable of matching a human face from a digital image or a video frame against a database of faces.
 
• **Gesture recognition** is a topic in computer science and language technology with the goal of interpreting human gestures via mathematical algorithms.
 
• **Pattern recognition** is the automated recognition of patterns and regularities in data.
